problem_text:
A city planner must distribute a fixed budget across 17 different public infrastructure projects to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.032, impact factor 0.074, allocation limits [0.043, 0.343]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.112, impact factor 0.069, allocation limits [0.047, 0.323]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.155, impact factor 0.260, allocation limits [0.041, 0.420]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.136, impact factor 0.125, allocation limits [0.080, 0.418]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.112, impact factor 0.099, allocation limits [0.032, 0.498]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.110, impact factor 0.268, allocation limits [0.038, 0.482]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.104, impact factor 0.176, allocation limits [0.018, 0.789]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.078, impact factor 0.281, allocation limits [0.023, 0.710]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.087, impact factor 0.118, allocation limits [0.065, 0.465]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.145, impact factor 0.170, allocation limits [0.036, 0.723]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.149, impact factor 0.049, allocation limits [0.008, 0.899]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.109, impact factor 0.034, allocation limits [0.084, 0.899]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.068, impact factor 0.139, allocation limits [0.051, 0.751]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.092, impact factor 0.112, allocation limits [0.064, 0.744]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.186, impact factor 0.179, allocation limits [0.079, 0.847]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.125, impact factor 0.145, allocation limits [0.093, 0.305]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.027, impact factor 0.190, allocation limits [0.010, 0.480]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all projects must sum to one. To ensure timely completion, the set of high-priority projects L = {A, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q} must collectively receive at least 0.729 of the total budget. Additionally, the overall impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.204, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.072. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
